name: Cable Shrug-In
summary: A standing shrug performed between two low cable pulleys, targeting the upper traps by aligning resistance with their diagonal line of pull.

setup: Set the pulleys of a dual cable station to the lowest position and attach a single D-handle to each side.
Stand centered between the pulleys with feet hip-width apart.
Grasp a handle in each hand with a neutral grip and stand fully upright with arms straight, allowing the cables to pull downward and outward.
steps: Keeping your arms completely straight, elevate your shoulders upward and inward toward your ears along the line of the cables.
Pause for a second at the top of the movement to contract the upper trapezius fully.
Lower your shoulders under control, allowing the cables to pull your shoulder blades down and out into a deep stretch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you shrug upward and inward; inhale smoothly as you lower the weight.
cues: Shrug up and in toward your ears
Pause and squeeze at the peak
Control the stretch at the bottom

common_faults.fault: Bending the elbows to pull the weight with the biceps.
common_faults.correction: Keep the arms fully extended and let the movement occur entirely at the shoulder blades.

common_faults.fault: Rolling the shoulders forward during the shrug.
common_faults.correction: Move straight up and inward along the diagonal angle of the cables without rolling the joints.

common_faults.fault: Using leg drive or torso bobbing to move the load.
common_faults.correction: Brace the core, lock the knees softly, and elevate solely using the traps.

precautions: Avoid jerking the head forward or thrusting the chin during the contraction to protect the cervical spine.
